video_title: Frustrated With His Cavs Role, Shump Was Told to Watch Kevin Love

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Kevin Love's sacrifice and role in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: If it wasn't for Kevin Love, if it wasn't for Richard Jefferson, if it wasn't for Channing Frye

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: I feel like a lot of times during that season, if it wasn't for him, if it wasn't for Richard Jefferson, if it wasn't for Channing Frye saying, 'Shump, you think you're frustrated? Look at Kevin Love.' He was the best power forward in the league. He like, 'Yeah, that's a walking 30-20.' This is outlet passes. That's what winning looked like.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: He was the best power forward in the league.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on his veteran role and sacrifice in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I wanted to do whatever it took to be a part of the group.
quotes.quote: James Jones was big in keeping us there, but I was at year 15, so the sacrifice for me was different. I wanted to do whatever it took to be a part of the group. My 'I want to see what I can go prove' days were long behind me. I knew what my role was, so it was also part of my job as a person that wanted to win was to help convince people of their roles.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on accepting a role for team success
quotes.excerpt: Accept that role and that place for winning.
quotes.quote: When I got to Phoenix, Grant Hill was like, 'Listen, people are going to talk shit about you. But we're going to win.' He goes, 'Channing, Steve is a two-time MVP. Amar'e Stoudemire is like a four-time All-Star. You see Jason Richardson, he's like a two or three-time All-Star. You standing right here and doing your job and being available to shoot and working on that creates opportunities for everyone else to play four-on-four basketball.' So when I got to Cleveland, I was like, 'Shump, we know you're great. I respect the shit out of Shump. Shump is very talented. But Shump compared to talent compared to Kevin, Kyrie, Swish, and Bron, you got to simplify your game so that your consistency we can rely on.' And that was my attitude towards it. It's like, dude, look what Kevin is doing. We had arguments, is Kevin the best power forward versus Tim Duncan? Those are real arguments. And now Kevin is doing Channing Frye things to win. So brother, we all got to eat less, but we're all going to eat at the buffet at the end of it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James helped J.R. Smith reach a new level of professionalism
quotes.excerpt: LeBron wrapped his arm around him and all of a sudden LeBron taught Swish another level of professionalism.
quotes.quote: The trade that happened to get Shump and Swish wasn't for Swish. Shump was just injured and then all of a sudden Swish stepped into a role because he was almost a throw-in into that trade and got an opportunity and then he capitalized because he started to make shots and then LeBron wrapped his arm around him and all of a sudden LeBron taught Swish another level of professionalism. So Shump had to come in to a point of almost proving himself.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Garnett set the tone for the 2008 Celtics championship
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Garnett set the tone from the jump, the first day of training camp in Rome.
quotes.quote: Outside of having the talent, the two most important things to winning the championship, being on a team to win the championship, is number one, it's health and number two is sacrificing. If you're not going to sacrifice, you're not going to win. I went to the NBA Finals five times, I won once. And the one time that I won is because everybody lost themselves in the team. Kevin Garnett set the tone from the jump, the first day of training camp in Rome. He came in and he said, 'Doc, before you get started, we're going to run this offense through Paul and Ray.' The world knew that Kevin Garnett was the best player on our team. No, we're going to run this offense. If you need me, I'm here, I'm going to focus defensively. That set the tone early.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of sacrificing individual goals for team championship success
quotes.excerpt: It's one thing to talk about it and have the talent, but the hardest thing is to sacrifice.
quotes.quote: For a young guy like Shump that was like in his prime, coming off of ACL injury, has started off with the Knicks extremely well, was, you know, shit was looking promising, yeah you want to win a championship, but you want to get to a bag, you want to make a couple of All-Star games, you want to see where your talent actually is going to take you. So it's a real moment to highlight and show the world and show these teams out here that are actually trying to win right now this season, that it's one thing to talk about it and have the talent, but the hardest thing in the world is to sacrifice. You have to do an outstanding job of policing and keeping yourself accountable and making sure you sacrifice.
